description_en: Creates a power of attorney. If the qualification is applied for third-party use or the signature involves third-party rights, you must obtain third-party authorization and create a power of attorney before submitting the application
description_zh: 若申请的资质用途为他用或申请的签名涉及第三方权益，则必须获取第三方授权，并在申请前提前创建授权委托书
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-sms-authorization-letter --authorization-letter-pic 123456/test1719383196031.jpg --sign-list 菜鸟网络 --authorization-letter-exp-date '2023-01-01~2026-01-01' --authorization '菜鸟网络科技有限公司' --organization-code 90000000000000000A --proxy-authorization '支付宝（中国）网络技术有限公司' --authorization-letter-name '菜鸟公司授权书' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSmsAuthorizationLetter

parameters.help_en:
The file key of the power of attorney.

The file information of the power of attorney uploaded to OSS. Download the Power of attorney template (https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20250414/bvpcmo/%E6%8E%88%E6%9D%83%E5%A7%94%E6%89%98%E4%B9%A6%E6%A8%A1%E7%89%88.doc), fill in the template according to the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56741.html, stamp it, and upload it. File upload requirements:
The file name cannot contain Chinese characters or special characters.
Only images in JPG, PNG, GIF, or JPEG format are supported. The image size cannot exceed 5 MB.

For information about how to obtain the fileKey, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html
parameters.help_zh:
委托授权书的fileKey。

上传到OSS的授权委托书文件信息。请下载授权委托书模板 (https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20250414/bvpcmo/%E6%8E%88%E6%9D%83%E5%A7%94%E6%89%98%E4%B9%A6%E6%A8%A1%E7%89%88.doc)后，根据https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56741.html完成填写并盖章后上传。文件上传要求：
待上传的文件命名不可包含中文和特殊字符。
仅支持jpg、png、gif、jpeg格式的图片，图片不大于5MB。

fileKey的获取方式如下：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833114.html
parameters.name: authorization_letter_pic

parameters.help_en:
The list of authorized signatures. The number of signatures cannot exceed 100.

We recommend that you authorize all signatures that you may need in the authorization letter at one time. This prevents signature applications from being rejected because the signature is not within the scope of the authorization letter, which would require you to create a new power of attorney
parameters.help_zh:
委托授权签名列表，签名数量不超过100个。

建议您在授权书内将可能需要用到的签名一次性全部授权，避免后续申请签名时不在授权书签名范围内，导致审核不通过且需重新补充委托授权书
parameters.name: sign_list

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the power of attorney. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD~YYYY-MM-DD`.

The validity period is recommended to be 1 to 3 years. Set a reasonable time period to avoid an excessively long or short validity period
parameters.help_zh:
授权委托书有效期。有效期格式：`YYYY-MM-DD~YYYY-MM-DD`。

有效期限建议为1~3年。请设定一个合理的时间周期，避免有效期过长或过短
parameters.name: authorization_letter_exp_date

parameters.example: 菜鸟网络科技有限公司
parameters.help_en: The authorizer, which is the signature owner. Only middle dot `·`, Chinese brackets `【】（）`, English brackets `()`, and spaces are supported. Other symbols or pure numbers are not allowed. The length cannot exceed 150 characters
parameters.help_zh: 委托授权方，即签名归属方。符号仅支持中点`·`、中文`【】（）`、英文`()`及空格，不可含其他符号或纯数字，长度不超过150字符
parameters.name: authorization

parameters.help_en: The unified social credit code of the authorizer. The length cannot exceed 150 characters. The credit code must be consistent with the unified social credit code field in the qualification information bound to the signature. Otherwise, the signature creation fails
parameters.help_zh: 委托授权方社会统一信用代码，长度不超过150字符。信用代码必须与签名绑定的资质信息中社会统一信用代码字段保持一致，否则创建签名失败
parameters.name: organization_code

parameters.example: 支付宝（中国）网络技术有限公司
parameters.help_en: The authorized party, which is the signature applicant. Only middle dot `·`, Chinese brackets `【】（）`, English brackets `()`, and spaces are supported. Other symbols or pure numbers are not allowed. The length cannot exceed 150 characters
parameters.help_zh: 被委托授权方，即签名申请方。符号仅支持中点`·`、中文`【】（）`、英文`()`及空格，不可含其他符号或纯数字，长度不超过150字符
parameters.name: proxy_authorization

parameters.help_en: The name of the power of attorney. The name cannot be the same as any of your other authorization letters. Only Chinese characters, English characters, or combinations with numbers are supported. Symbols or pure numbers are not allowed. The length cannot exceed 100 characters
parameters.help_zh: 授权委托书命名。命名不可与您其他授权书重复，仅支持中文、英文或与数字组合，不可含符号或纯数字，长度不超过100字符
parameters.name: authorization_letter_name
